coverage_heuristics.notes: Pure feel-layer story: no API endpoints, no auth surfaces, no UI journey E2E in host automation (Taptic Engine requires real iPhone). Negative paths covered via AC4 NOOP/never-throw sweeps (null/undefined/empty, spawned:true, from.length!==2) and AC3 Reduced Motion independence. Happy-path-only gaps: 0 — every I/O row has boundary + error case. E2E-equivalent P1-05 device smoke (real iPhone 3/6/12+ + Reduced Motion ON + airplane) is manual pre-merge lane, not scaffolded as code by design (see test-design Execution Order > Device gate).
